description: Codex adapters for the harness scope/write and terminal-claim gates. Review and trust in Codex before use. The role-ledger entries are partial: spawn_agent entry and Stop turn_end only; Codex exposes no subagent-stop event.

hooks.command: sh -c 'PY=${COAUTHOR_HOOK_PYTHON:-${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_PYTHON:-}}; [ -n "$PY" ] || PY=$(command -v python3 || command -v python || true); [ -n "$PY" ] || { echo "ROLE-LEDGER: no usable Python; event not recorded" >&2; exit 0; }; COAUTHOR_ROLE_LEDGER_HOST=codex "$PY" -B "${PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/hooks/role_ledger.py" || exit 0'
